# Basic Example

This example creates a minimal development-to-test deployment pipeline without Entra ID sharing.
To enable sharing, provide the `security_group_id` argument pointing to an Entra ID security group.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD033 -->
## Requirements

The following requirements are needed by this module:

- <a name="requirement_terraform"></a> [terraform](#requirement\_terraform) (>= 1.9, < 2.0)

- <a name="requirement_powerplatform"></a> [powerplatform](#requirement\_powerplatform) (~> 4.0)

## Resources

No resources.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_dev_environment_id"></a> [dev\_environment\_id](#input\_dev\_environment\_id)

Description: The Power Platform environment ID of the development environment.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_host_environment_id"></a> [host\_environment\_id](#input\_host\_environment\_id)

Description: The Power Platform environment ID of the Pipelines Host environment.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_pipeline_name"></a> [pipeline\_name](#input\_pipeline\_name)

Description: The display name of the deployment pipeline.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_pipelines_host_url"></a> [pipelines\_host\_url](#input\_pipelines\_host\_url)

Description: The Dataverse API URL for the Pipelines Host environment.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_test_environment_id"></a> [test\_environment\_id](#input\_test\_environment\_id)

Description: The Power Platform environment ID of the test environment.

Type: `string`

No optional inputs.
